pageDescription: 1,200 illustrated questions, three difficulty levels, 20-question games, and a timed challenge. Learn something with every answer.
title: The choice is yours.
intro: One question, one discovery. Explore animals and the remarkable things they do.
timedRules: +{count} seconds per correct answer. Time stops during the explanations and resumes with the next question. No repeated questions in the game.
discoveryRules: 20 questions to make learning fun, with no time limit. After each answer, read an explanation and a “Did you know?” fact about a different aspect of the same animal.
free: Free to play · Questions in your language · No account needed
incorrectNote: Curiosity helps you learn. Here’s the answer.
tryDiscovery: Start a new game at your own pace in Discovery mode.
storageUnavailable: Device storage is unavailable, so your result could not be saved.
externalEnglish: Opens in a new tab · English

dogHappy: A happy dog wags its tail

photoAlt: Photo of the animal in the question

globalUpcoming: The general leaderboard is live. Compare your results with players in the same category and level.
friendsUpcoming: Friend rankings will be available when community profiles and connections launch.
rankingRules: Ranked games contain 20 questions and are compared by category and difficulty. Only your best score counts. Timed games remain unranked practice.
